title: NKSC powers and responsibilities
description: Determine the full scope of powers held by the National Cyber Security Centre.
query: What is the full scope of NKSC's powers and responsibilities across all Lithuanian cybersecurity legislation? How have these evolved over time?

title: Maximum penalty exposure for regulated entities
description: Calculate the maximum financial and operational penalty exposure for different entity types.
query: What is the maximum penalty exposure for essential entities versus important entities under Lithuanian law? Include financial penalties, turnover percentage caps, executive liability, and operational sanctions.

title: Legislative response to Russian threats
description: Analyse legislation specifically addressing Russian and Belarusian threats.
query: How does Lithuanian legislation specifically address threats from Russia and Belarus? What supply chain restrictions, strategic decoupling mandates, and defensive measures are in place?

title: Incident reporting chain analysis
description: Trace the complete incident reporting chain from regulated entity to authority.
query: Trace the complete incident reporting chain: when a cybersecurity incident occurs at a regulated entity, who must they report to, through what information pipelines, within what time windows, and what happens next?

title: Personal risk for executives
description: Assess the personal liability exposure of corporate executives under Lithuanian cyber law.
query: What personal liability risks do C-level executives face under Lithuanian cybersecurity and national security laws? What specific provisions create personal rather than corporate accountability?

title: EU directive alignment gaps
description: Identify areas where Lithuanian transposition may diverge from or exceed EU requirements.
query: Are there areas where Lithuanian law goes beyond what EU directives require, or where transposition may have gaps? Compare the domestic provisions against the referenced EU directives.

title: Civilian mobilisation and defence obligations
description: Analyse the civilian mobilisation and host-nation defence support framework.
query: What civilian mobilisation and host-nation defence support obligations exist in Lithuanian law? How do these interact with cybersecurity infrastructure and the Secure Network?

title: Oversight and accountability mechanisms
description: Assess the oversight mechanisms protecting against state overreach.
query: What oversight bodies and accountability mechanisms exist to protect citizens and entities from potential state overreach in cybersecurity enforcement? How can penalties be challenged?
